summary: XCel Brands filed an 8-K (Item 8.01) to disclose routine equity drawdowns under a common stock purchase agreement with White Lion Capital LLC. On May 20 and 22, 2026, the company issued 2,500 and 5,000 shares, respectively, at average purchase prices of $1.98 and $2.14, for total proceeds of $15,650. These at-the-market sales are part of a pre-existing $15 million committed facility and represent a periodic funding disclosure, not a special-situation event. No board recommendation, advisor, or unusual structural terms are noted. This is a standard current report of ongoing financing activity.
